query: SELECT w.id FROM workspaces w WHERE w.state='ready' AND w.lease_conversation_id IS NULL AND COALESCE(w.last_used_at, w.created_at) < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - make_interval(secs=>$1) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM conversations c WHERE c.workspace_id=w.id AND c.state='active') ORDER BY COALESCE(w.last_used_at, w.created_at) LIMIT $2
